title: The full gate and the wheel check after the reasoning-field and harness-learning packages
request: The owner asked to finish what was left: the full gate and dclab_core's wheel check, owed since the day's packages (D2 P1 to P5, learning H0 to H2) ran only their own tests under the daytime rule.
spec: make check-all (the gates, the suite on files and on PostgreSQL, the campaign agent's tests, the end-to-end flows) and make core-wheel-check (dclab_core 0.103.0 built, installed in a clean Python 3.12 with its dependencies only, and run).
plan: run the full gate; read every failure in full
fix each at its cause, run the failing files on files and on PostgreSQL
run the wheel check; list every stale smoke check at once rather than one at a time

decisions.decision: The stale smoke check's sentence names the accounts again instead of the check being weakened
decisions.why: since 30.6 a problem's parts are only the ones a person asks for; the later checks were written around the rings of linked accounts, so the faithful fix restores the input, not the expectation

decisions.decision: The smoke script was run with soft assertions once to list every stale check
decisions.why: fixing the first failure and running the whole wheel again, one at a time, hides how much went stale

change: dclab_rnd/learning/refusal.py (a test path that spelled a setting's name); dclab_rnd/store/tasks.py (the learning agent's capture rule); dclab_core/adapters/conformance.py (the five new contracts as library output, with the reason); scripts/core_wheel_check.py (the fraud sentence names the accounts; the catalogue has seventeen approaches).

findings.defect: an upper-case test path in the refusal test read as an undocumented setting
findings.scenario: tests/test_config.py found a setting named like the package in capitals
findings.cause: the config check reads every name of that shape in the code
findings.fix: the path written in mixed case, still upper-case enough to test the case rule

findings.defect: the new learning agent named no capture rule
findings.scenario: tests/test_store.py requires every harness agent in the store's task table
findings.cause: H0 registered the agent in the harness only
findings.fix: its rule: agent steps, each with its verdict and codes
findings.impact: an agent whose records no rule checks

findings.defect: the five new contracts had neither a main-product adapter nor a reason
findings.scenario: the conformance gate lists every contract without one
findings.cause: H0 and H2 added contracts without the conformance table
findings.fix: each recorded as library output with why: the main product would grade its own agents through them when it runs the loop
findings.impact: the main product's integration guide silent on them

findings.defect: the wheel's smoke test had gone stale twice before today: a fraud sentence that no longer draws the account part, and a catalogue counted at sixteen
findings.scenario: make core-wheel-check failed on the problem map and the solution catalogue
findings.cause: 30.6 drew only the parts asked for and 30.16 added the seventeenth approach; the wheel check was not run after either
findings.fix: the sentence names the accounts; the count is seventeen
findings.impact: the library's install check red for days
alternatives: expect three parts and drop the account checks (would test less)

measurements.name: the full gate
measurements.gate: every gate, the suite on files and on PostgreSQL, the agent tests and the flows pass
measurements.result: the gates and all five end-to-end flows passed; three test files failed on both stores, all registrations, fixed and passing on files and on PostgreSQL
limits: the suite was rerun for the failing files only, not whole

measurements.name: the wheel check
measurements.gate: dclab_core built, installed in a clean Python, run on a replica
measurements.result: passed after F4: the library installs with its four direct dependencies only and solves the replica
measurements.next: run it after every dclab_core change

outcome: The day's packages pass the full gate's checks and the library's install check; the registrations every new agent and contract needs are made.
lessons: A new agent or contract is registered in four places: the harness, the store's capture rules, the conformance table and the schemas.
Run the wheel check after every change to the library: a skipped check goes stale silently.
